eyebrow: The bug that breaks a stdio server
code:
import logging
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

logger.info("Processing request")  # stderr -- safe
# print("Processing request")     # stdout -- BREAKS IT

stdio uses stdout as the actual message
channel -- print() corrupts the JSON-RPC stream.
caption: Never print() inside a stdio server. logging is safe; HTTP servers don't have this problem.
